_comment: Constrained-English corpus for tests/test_spec.py. status: PASS (complete), UNVERIFIED (open questions listed by field), INVALID_INPUT (error substrings). same_as: a hand-written .espec with the same fingerprint.

cases.name: divider
cases.text: Name: divider. A 5 V supply V1 on VIN. R1 is a 10k 1% 0603 resistor from VIN to OUT. R2 is a 20k resistor in 0603 package from OUT to GND. OUT must be between 3.2 V and 3.4 V. The board is 40 x 30 mm with 2 layers. Run a DC analysis. Run an AC sweep from 10 Hz to 100 kHz with 50 points.

cases.name: divider reordered with aliases
cases.text: Run an AC sweep from 10Hz to 0.1MHz with 50 points; simulate dc. Board: 40 mm x 30 mm, two layers. The voltage at OUT should stay within 3.2 V and 3.4V. R2 is a 20 kohm 0603 resistor between OUT and ground. R1 is a 10000 ohm 1% resistor in 0603 package from VIN to OUT. V1 is a 5V supply on VIN. Name: divider

cases.name: divider board
cases.text: Name: divider_board. A 5 V supply V1 on VIN. R1 is a 10k 1% 0603 resistor from VIN to OUT. R2 is a 20k resistor in 0603 package from OUT to GND. J1 is a connector. J1 uses part header3. J1 pin 1 is on VIN. J1 pin 2 is on OUT. J1 pin 3 is on GND. OUT must be between 3.2 V and 3.4 V. The board is 40 x 30 mm with 2 layers.

cases.name: rc filter with unicode units
cases.text: A 3V3 supply on VDD. A 4k7 resistor R1 from VDD to OUT. A 100 nF capacitor C1 between OUT and GND. Transient with step 1 µs for 1 ms using trapezoidal.

cases.name: micro sign and ohm sign
cases.text: a 2.2 μF capacitor between VIN and GND, a 1 kΩ resistor between VIN and GND, a 1.5 V supply on VIN

cases.name: missing capacitor value
cases.text: a 5 V supply on VIN. a capacitor C1 between VIN and GND

cases.name: esp32 family only
cases.text: Use an ESP32 module. GPIO2 drives the LED. A red LED from OUT to GND.

cases.name: esp32 exact module
cases.text: U1 is an ESP32-WROOM-32E module. U1 GPIO2 drives D1. D1 is a green LED from IO2 to GND.

cases.name: two mcus, gpio without owner
cases.text: an ESP32-WROOM-32E module U1. an RP2040 chip U2. GPIO5 drives the LED. a red LED from SIG to GND

cases.name: usb power is ambiguous
cases.text: a USB power input. a 1k resistor from VBUS to GND

cases.name: powered by without a voltage
cases.text: The board is powered by a battery. a 1k resistor from VBAT to GND

cases.name: diode polarity
cases.text: a 5 V supply on VIN. a diode D1 between VIN and OUT. a 1k resistor from OUT to GND

cases.name: missing ground
cases.text: a 5 V supply V1 between VIN and VNEG. a 1k resistor from VIN to VNEG

cases.name: zero ohm resistor
cases.text: a 0 ohm resistor between VIN and GND

cases.name: nan and inf
cases.text: a NaN ohm resistor between VIN and GND. an inf F capacitor between VIN and GND
errors: nan is not a finite number
inf is not a finite number

cases.name: negative capacitance
cases.text: a -1uF capacitor between VIN and GND

cases.name: unit mismatch
cases.text: a 10 V resistor between VIN and GND
errors: unit V where ohm is required

cases.name: invalid terminal
cases.text: a 1k resistor R1. R1 pin 3 to VIN

cases.name: contradictory connection
cases.text: a 1k resistor R1 from VIN to GND. R1 pin 1 to OUT

cases.name: undeclared reference
cases.text: R7 pin 1 to VIN

cases.name: wrong reference prefix
cases.text: C1 is a 10k resistor between VIN and GND

cases.name: unrecognized text
cases.text: a 1k resistor between VIN and GND. make it blink nicely

cases.name: requirement on an unknown net
cases.text: a 5 V supply on VIN. a 1k resistor between VIN and GND. OUT must be at least 1 V
